title: Wave 9 official ONS schema, OS UPRN lifecycle and HMLR boundary research

findings.finding: Latest May 2026 centroid layer is EPSG:27700, maxRecordCount 2,000 and exposes postcode identity, lifecycle, grid, administrative and latitude/longitude fields.
May 2026 hosted table is a separate no-geometry service with maxRecordCount 1,000 and lower-case string fields.
Publication and correction receipts are 10 June 2026 and 4 June 2026 respectively; service edit timestamps are not substitutes for the data snapshot.
OS Open UPRN uses a 12-digit integer identifier, point geometry in British National Grid, all lifecycle states and a six-week cadence.
Current INSPIRE snapshot is 5 July 2026; polygons are indicative freehold extents, can duplicate across authority files and can shift by up to 15 m after WGS84 reprojection.
Exact ten-postcode ONS query produced zero accepted rows because browser safe-URL and container DNS gates blocked transport.
